_note: Every row generates one system struct in mod/content.lua via tools/generate.py. Columns are keys; no cell may stay TODO.

systems.name: Rust-style day/night cycle
systems.rule_source: Rust server defaults: day length 45 min, night 15 min (public convention)
systems.in_scrap: drives the raid scheduler; SM world time is mapped onto it

systems.name: Base decay
systems.rule_source: Rust tool/cupboard decay concept, re-themed to SM blocks
systems.in_scrap: unclaimed player blocks lose integrity over time near the survival area

systems.name: Loot crates
systems.rule_source: crate contents table = loot.json rows, each row's rust_item resolved from the player's own Rust cfg at runtime
systems.in_scrap: harvest-container style crates placed on a timed spawn schedule

systems.name: Night raids
systems.rule_source: raids.json waves; AI uses SM's existing hostile-creature spawner API
systems.in_scrap: wave of hostile scrap-bots attacks the base at first nightfall

systems.name: Live Rust data reader
systems.rule_source: reads {RUST_FOLDER}/cfg/weapons/*.json at level start; folder passed by Melty as env RUST_FOLDER
systems.in_scrap: weapon names/damage/ammo shown in crate drops and HUD log lines come from the player's real Rust files
systems.fallback: if Rust folder missing or unreadable, use bundled definitions in data/fallback_items.json and mark them as fallback in the log
